tools.name: inspect_unity_project
tools.description: Read-only check whether kiss-unity-mcp is installed in a Unity project. Returns JSON state: installed, not_installed, or conflict. Never installs anything.

tools.name: setup_unity_project
tools.description: Explicit one-time filesystem install of the embedded package, Bash tools, tools.env and VS Code workspace. Only when the user asks for setup and inspect reported not_installed. Refuses conflicts; never opens Unity or edits Packages/manifest.json.

dry_run.description: true = inspect only, identical to inspect_unity_project.

tools.name: unity_doctor
tools.description: Resolve the project's exact Unity editor and Rider/MSBuild paths without launching them. Use when a tool reports a missing editor or ambiguous MSBuild. Fix paths in <project>/.kissunitymcp/tools.env.

tools.name: unity_import
tools.description: Authoritative headless Unity import + full C# compile + solution regeneration (slow, minutes). Required after adding/removing files, assets, asmdefs, packages, shaders or settings, and before the first unity_build. Close the interactive Unity editor first. The result already contains the verdict and extracted diagnostics.

tools.name: unity_build
tools.description: Fast incremental MSBuild of the generated solution without launching Unity (seconds). Valid only for edits to existing .cs files after a successful unity_import; a stale-snapshot error means run unity_import instead. The result already contains the verdict and compiler errors.

tools.name: unity_tests
tools.description: Run Unity Test Framework tests headlessly (no open editor). Prefer test_filter to run one fixture or one test instead of the whole suite. Close the interactive Unity editor first. The result already contains the summary, each failure's message and stack trace, and extracted diagnostics; exit 2 = failing tests, exit 1 = tool/compile failure.

test_filter.description: Run only matching tests. Fixture (class): "MyFixture" or "My.Namespace.MyFixture"; single test: "My.Namespace.MyFixture.MyTest"; parameterized: "MyFixture.MyTest(1)". Regex over the NUnit full name; semicolon-separated list allowed. Omit to run everything.

test_category.description: Run only tests with this NUnit [Category]; semicolon-separated list allowed.

assembly_names.description: Run only tests in these test assemblies (asmdef names); semicolon-separated list allowed.

tools.name: unity_shaders
tools.description: Reimport all project shaders headlessly and report Unity shader compiler errors. Close the interactive Unity editor first. The result already contains the verdict and extracted shader diagnostics.
